clue.text: Pa supple, however, for a dog?

parts.note: 'however' asks for the opposite: the opposite of Pa (father) is Ma (mother)
'however' asks for the opposite: the opposite of supple, bendy, is stiff

explanation.surface: A puzzled question about which dog suits a lithe father.
explanation.walkthrough: 'however' tells you to swap each word for its contrary: Pa becomes MA, supple becomes STIFF, giving MA'S TIFF read as one word.
explanation.definitionFit: The mastiff is a large, powerful breed of guard dog.

clue.text: Tummy, if here?

parts.note: the word if sits in the middle of the word riff, so it is the mid of riff

explanation.surface: A question about where the belly is.
explanation.walkthrough: A reverse clue: mid-riff, the middle of RIFF, would be a clue for IF.
explanation.definitionFit: The midriff is the middle part of the body, between chest and waist.

clue.text: Players' entrance, where male journalist and Australian native turned up

parts.note: a stag is a male deer
ED is short for editor, a journalist

indicators.note: in a down light, turned up means the word is read from the bottom upward

parts.note: the roo, short for kangaroo, is native to Australia

explanation.surface: Actors' doorway where a man, a reporter and a kangaroo appear.
explanation.definitionFit: Actors enter and leave a theatre by the stage door at the back.

clue.text: Fury, one having no head for peace

parts.note: fury is rage, ire

indicators.note: without a head means the first letter is dropped

explanation.surface: An angry spirit who cannot think of peace.
explanation.walkthrough: Peace is the Greek goddess, personified.
explanation.definitionFit: Irene (Eirene) was the Greek goddess personifying peace.

clue.text: Safety device I placed on concrete in rural property

indicators.note: in means the joined letters go inside the rural property

parts.note: a farm is property in the countryside

indicators.note: in a down light, placed on puts I above the next piece

parts.note: concrete means real, actual

explanation.surface: Someone fixes a safety device to a concrete farm building.
explanation.definitionFit: A fire alarm is a warning device triggered by smoke or heat.

clue.text: Last worker to get a drink

an iced drink of wine or sherry with sugar and fruit

explanation.surface: The final employee in line gets a beverage.
explanation.definitionFit: A shoe-mender works on a last; separately, a sherry cobbler is a classic mixed drink.

clue.text: Heading for cheetah, I check out catlike carnivore

indicators.note: the heading of the word cheetah is its opening letter

parts.note: to vet is to check out or examine

explanation.surface: Someone heading towards a cheetah to examine a big cat.
explanation.definitionFit: The civet is a small cat-like mammal of Africa and Asia.

clue.text: Third of poachers feeling awful standing among pheasants perhaps, pocketing game

indicators.note: among puts the pieces inside the game birds

parts.note: pheasants are an example of birds

indicators.note: in a down light, standing means set upright, read from the bottom up
the third letter of the word poachers

parts.note: feeling awful is being ill

explanation.surface: A poacher feels guilty standing among pheasants and pocketing game.
explanation.walkthrough: 'standing' turns the A and the ILL upside down in this down light, so the pair reads LLIA; pheasants stand for game birds in general.
explanation.definitionFit: Billiards is a cue game in which balls are pocketed.

clue.text: Dishonest swimmer given unknown injection?

parts.note: the ling is a sea fish, a swimmer
Y is a mathematical unknown

explanation.surface: A cheating athlete given a mystery drug.
explanation.definitionFit: Lying means telling untruths, so being deceitful and untrustworthy.

clue.text: Girl they upset having expended energy, for good reason

indicators.note: upset means knocked over, so the letters are tipped into a new order
expended means used up, so the letter is spent and removed

parts.note: E is the physics symbol for energy

explanation.walkthrough: 'having expended' takes E from GIRLTHEY, and 'upset' rearranges what is left.
explanation.definitionFit: Rightly means justifiably, with good cause.

clue.text: Admiral, male taking instinctively to water?

definitions.meaning: a male duck, which takes to water by instinct

explanation.surface: A naval commander is a man naturally drawn to the sea.
explanation.definitionFit: Francis Drake was an English admiral; a male duck is called by the same name.

clue.text: Horrible participating in a putsch?

clue.text: Awkward tangle in middle of web after weaving

the middle of the word web is its central letter

explanation.definitionFit: Clumsy and lacking grace, as an inelegant phrase or movement is.

clue.text: Block when batting, then caught

parts.note: a cricket side that is batting is said to be in
caught means got, as in got a cold

explanation.surface: A cricket moment: a batsman blocks the ball and is then caught out.
explanation.definitionFit: An ingot is a block of cast metal such as gold.

clue.text: Casualty after fine thread

parts.note: F is the pencil-grade abbreviation for fine
a casualty is a loss, as in losses in battle

clue.text: Green Party supporting leader in scandal, one involved in sleaze

parts.note: lime is a shade of green
a ball is a formal dancing party

explanation.definitionFit: A slimeball is slang for a repellent, sleazy person.

clue.text: Opponent very sad, a competitor finally beaten

finally picks the closing letter of the word competitor

explanation.surface: A rival is miserable after a competitor finally loses.
explanation.definitionFit: An adversary is an enemy or rival you face in a contest.

clue.text: Bodily chamber opening, contamination's first found in gall

parts.note: a vent is an opening or outlet

indicators.note: found in places the letter inside the word for gall

parts.note: to gall is to annoy, to rile

indicators.note: the first of the word contamination is its opening letter

explanation.surface: A medical report of contamination in an organ near the gall bladder.
explanation.walkthrough: Gall misleads as the bile organ; here it is the verb to annoy.
explanation.definitionFit: A ventricle is one of the heart's lower chambers, or a cavity in the brain.

clue.text: Great thinker once designing toilets south of the centre of Kilmarnock

indicators.note: in a down light, south of means placed below
the centre of the ten-letter word Kilmarnock is its middle pair
designing means planning out afresh, so the letters are arranged anew

explanation.walkthrough: Kilmarnock is a town in Ayrshire, Scotland.
explanation.definitionFit: Aristotle was the ancient Greek philosopher, a great thinker of the past.

clue.text: Someone eating very little fruit

parts.note: someone is a person
one millimetre, I MM, is a very small measure

explanation.walkthrough: IMM is 1 mm, written I for one plus MM for millimetre.
explanation.definitionFit: The persimmon is an orange tropical fruit, also called the sharon fruit.

clue.text: Local liberal is last to finish, so put out

indicators.note: the last letter of the word finish

explanation.definitionFit: To publish a book is to issue it, to put it out.

clue.text: Arrest Catholic extremists, did you say?

the extremists of the word Catholic are its first and last letters

explanation.definitionFit: To seize someone is to take hold of them, which is what an arrest does.

clue.text: One's heard within this ethos a right to change

indicators.note: the letters are changed into a new order

explanation.definitionFit: Earshot is the range within which a person can hear or be heard.

clue.text: Token nocturnal animal having tail docked

parts.note: the badger is a black-and-white animal active at night

explanation.surface: A night creature with a shortened tail, presented as a symbol.

clue.text: Vision, draft initially put on paper

parts.note: a ream is a quantity of paper, 500 sheets

clue.text: One swallowing a tree drinking western liquor!

clue.text: Foul in football? Expect trouble in derby, all kicking off

clue.text: Rigid tails, nice when wagging

clue.text: D-desire to dump

clue.text: Novel held, I'm not sure book held will be put down

clue.text: Beginning to eat fast, Mudd getting trapped wind, perhaps

the setter is caught inside the period of fasting
